Ðæs fýrhýses hlýwing[e] winterlíces cyles and ungetemprunge wiþerrǽdnes sí gelýht
quotations.latin: caumene refugio hybernalis algoris et intemperei adversitas leuigetur

source_text: wiþer-rǽdness, e; f. Contrariety, opposition :-- Wiðerrǽdnys contrarietas, contrauersio, Ælfc. Gr. 47; Zup. 275, 7. I. hostility, ill-will, v. wiþer-rǽde, I :-- Wið hunda réðnysse and wiðerrǽdnysse; se ðe hafaþ hundes heortan mid him, ne beóð ongeán hine hundas céne, Lchdm. i. 372, 3. II. unfavourableness, disadvantage, v. wiþerrǽde, IV :-- Ðæs fýrhýses hlýwing[e] winterlíces cyles and ungetemprunge wiþerrǽdnes sí gelýht caumene refugio hybernalis algoris et intemperei adversitas leuigetur, Anglia xiii. 397, 462. III. oppositeness of nature, v. wiþer-rǽde, V :-- On wiþerǽdnysse went in contrarium uertit, Scint. 55,
